prompts.steel: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square support artwork for a small circular action RPG skill icon. Primary request: a richly detailed real-material peripheral decoration backdrop, with weathered forged steel chips, small silver blade splinters, warm copper sparks and a little amber smoke; grounded warm steel-grey palette. Composition: the 3D photographed main skill object will be composited separately in the middle; keep the middle 45 percent width as an uncluttered dark translucent charcoal-blue region so the subject remains readable. Decorated perimeter fills an irregular circular area covering 90 percent of the square, with dense tactile material details on the left and lower and right outskirts; decorations subordinate to the middle. Use substantive solids with surface texture, cinematic soft light and physically believable volume, matching a moderately stylized 3D fantasy mobile game. A dark soft-edged material vignette inside the circle provides visual fullness. Real transparent alpha outside the circular vignette, clean transparent corners. No lettering, labels, symbols, spell glyphs, wireframe lines, geometrical diagrams, UI border, circular line, icon frame, watermark, hero, weapon, central subject or ground plane. Tight square framing.
